visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A standing chart plate with a dot-to-dot line path, a time axis and value axis, and a topic icon. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Chart plate: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Grid: faint warm-ink lines on the plate surface. Dots: small warm-ink spheres at each point. Connecting line: thin warm amber strip between dots. Pointer: small warm-grey marker gliding along the line. Thermometer icon: small warm paper tag. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: line graphs as trends over time — a chart plate with a 7-point temperature series; 'build' reveals dots one by one as segments connect; dots are draggable; 'trace' glides a pointer along the line.

GEOMETRY: A standing chart plate with a faint grid. Seven dots sit left to right (7a.m.-7a.m.), connected by line segments into a path that rises and dips. 'Build' animates dots and segments appearing in order. Dragging a dot re-adjusts its two neighboring segments. 'Trace' moves a small pointer along the line; a readout says whether the pointer is rising or falling. A small thermometer tag at top labels the series 'hourly temperature'.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) chart plate; (2) grid; (3) dots; (4) connecting line + pointer.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, slightly above, frames the full chart; labels legible. Budget 6-10k triangles. Named nodes: ChartPlate, Grid, Dots, Segments, Pointer, TimeAxis, ValueAxis, ThermometerTag. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
